title: Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
label_definition: next 96 standardized values for all eight exchange-rate channels
training_protocol: official LTSF-Linear exchange protocol: sequence length 336, prediction length 96, 70/10/20 chronological split, batch size 8, 10 epochs with patience 3, Adam and MSE loss, seed 2021
evaluation_protocol: fixed chronological 70/10/20 train-validation-test split with 336-step context overlap
preprocessing_protocol: StandardScaler fitted on the first 70% training partition and applied to validation/test

evidence_spans.quote: Exchange-Rate is an eight-variate financial time series benchmark.
The Exchange-Rate dataset contains eight foreign-exchange channels.
Exchange-Rate has 7,588 timesteps at one-day granularity.
The Exchange benchmark reports prediction length 96.
Long-term forecasting predicts future values of every variate from a historical input sequence.
Exchange-Rate contains 7,588 daily timesteps and eight variates.
The model receives a multivariate look-back window as input.
DLinear combines seasonal and trend linear projections after decomposition.
The official exchange script uses input length 336 and prediction length 96.
The official loader standardizes using statistics fitted on the training partition.
The official script uses batch 8, learning rate 0.0005, ten epochs and seed 2021.
The official loader applies chronological train, validation and test partitions.
Mean Squared Error and Mean Absolute Error are the core metrics.

extraction_metadata.preprocessing_protocol: StandardScaler fitted on the first 70% training partition and applied to validation/test
